items.title: Spiegle Willcox and Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Norwich, New York, November 14, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What was that guy, what was his name? Mark? The trombone player. [INTERVIEWEE] Ballard? Not Red Ballard.

ctx.x: Go ahead, I’ll get to mine.
